integrity: The result is derived analytically for every integer dimension at least two; 69 finite checks only corroborate explicit low-dimensional formulas. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform central directions through a centered Euclidean cube; not stationary-line chords or projection widths. General CDF is a finite integral. Complete prior texts of two relevant historical papers were inaccessible, leaving priority uncertainty.
title: Every facet-coincidence threshold in the random central chords of a Euclidean hypercube
